title: Jianzi
description: The feathered kicking game from the parks of China. Time each kick as the shuttle floats down, steer against the wind, chain different kicks into combos, or pass it around a circle of friends. Solo, circle, daily and Watch & Learn modes.
howToPlay: Tap a pad when the shuttle falls into the bright band beside your leg.
Left, straight or right steers the shuttle; in the circle each pad passes to a friend.
Strike near the white line for a Perfect kick; low is a toe scoop, high is the knee.
Use different kicks to raise the style multiplier and land combos.
Kick against the wind; the run ends when the shuttle touches the ground.
